scenario: TS-CORE-01 synthetic evidence moves from intentional Chrome capture through the account-scoped backend to human Web confirmation, one separately approved local effect with destination readback, iOS parity, and repository-local Codex analyzer parity.

review_plan.reason: Evaluate the end-to-end recruiter decision sequence, friction, and recovery.
Evaluate intentional capture, provenance, account scope, authority, outcome truth, and deletion.
Evaluate direct iOS backend parity, accessibility layout, and recovery.
Evaluate dignity, restraint, transparency, and avoidance of harmful candidate inference.
Evaluate evidence boundaries, uncertainty, job relevance, and prohibited scoring.

reviews.lens: time-constrained recruiter task completion, decision clarity, safe recovery, and inspectable outcomes

findings.observation: The Web flow completed from local sign-in through fact review, separate effect approval, and verified readback, but no uncoached first-use recording was captured.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/overnight/final/web-review-sequence.json records the real Chrome sequence; docs/evaluations/overnight/final/web-desktop-before-review.png and web-desktop-verified-light.png show its endpoints.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter can complete the work, but the evidence does not prove that a first-time operator will understand every transition without help.
findings.recommendation: Run one uncoached recruiter walkthrough and record where the operator hesitates or misstates the difference between confirmation, approval, and verification.
findings.verification: A first-time reviewer completes the same TS-CORE-01 path without prompting and correctly explains all three authority states.

findings.observation: The reviewed Web slice has a narrow screenshot, but the authenticated backend-owned sequence was not directly repeated at 390 px.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/overnight/final/web-review-sequence.json names the missing direct 390 px run; docs/evaluations/overnight/final/web-reviewed-slice-mobile-light.png is slice-only evidence.
findings.user_impact: The desktop path is proven, while a recruiter using a narrow browser may still encounter an unobserved layout or action-reachability issue.
findings.recommendation: Repeat the authenticated edit, confirm, approve, and readback sequence at 390 px in a controllable real browser.
findings.verification: The same backend version and verified outcome remain reachable at 390 px with no clipped evidence or hidden primary action.

strengths: The real Web flow makes the current evidence, four proposed facts, separate confirmation, one bounded action preview, and verified destination outcome visible in order.
Fact confirmation leaves the action unapproved, and approval still does not display success until destination readback matches.
The offline screen preserves the review state and the recovered screen returns to the same verified backend version.
open_questions: Would a recruiter prefer the four same-source confirmations as one explicit batch decision after inspecting each fact?

reviews.lens: intentional capture, provenance, identity and account scope, authority separation, deletion, and truthful outcome claims

findings.observation: The reviewed MV3 build and local transport are tested, but the authorized Chrome surface could not load the unpacked extension, grant activeTab through a visible toolbar invocation, or prove that no capture payload leaves before explicit Submit.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/overnight/final/chrome-load-unpacked-gap.json explicitly records blocked chrome://extensions access and lists load-unpacked, temporary activeTab grant, pre-Submit silence, and extension-to-backend receipt as unproven.
findings.user_impact: Candidate conversation evidence could be collected outside the intended visible, user-scoped capture boundary without this run detecting it.
findings.recommendation: Repeat TS-CORE-01 in a policy-authorized user-visible Chrome profile, load the exact frozen unpacked build, invoke the toolbar or selected-text capture, inspect the exact preview, and record network silence until Submit.
findings.verification: One direct recording and trace show no background-tab or history access, no pre-Submit capture request, one explicit Submit, and one account-scoped synthetic backend receipt.

strengths: The backend keeps capture receipt, proposed assertions, confirmed state, action approval, effect attempt, and observed readback as distinct account-scoped records.
Cross-account denial, deletion propagation, revocation, timeout reconciliation, and duplicate idempotency passed deterministic boundary checks.
Web never calls a receipt confirmation and reports verified only after the local destination readback matches the separately approved effect.
Every frozen payload is synthetic and localhost-bound; no live candidate data or external write was used.
missing_evidence: Positive temporary activeTab or explicit selected-text grant.
Real extension-to-backend receipt tied to the visible invocation.
vetoes: XS-CAPTURE-01: the intentional Chrome capture and pre-Submit silence boundary is unproven.

reviews.lens: iOS task completion, touch and accessibility layout, state semantics, backend parity, and failure recovery

findings.observation: The iOS UI passed AX5 dark-mode reachability and accessibility identifier checks, but no VoiceOver traversal transcript proves spoken labels, order, values, and state changes.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/overnight/final/ios-review-sequence.json records 12 passing UI tests and the AX5 dark screenshot at ios-ui-loop1-attachments/7126B23E-68B1-4008-ADE3-9569495D7EB4.png; it contains no VoiceOver transcript.
findings.user_impact: Large-text users are covered by direct evidence, while VoiceOver users may still encounter an unlabeled or confusing confirmation and outcome sequence.
findings.recommendation: Record a VoiceOver traversal of source evidence, each fact decision, action preview, and local outcome with the same localhost state.
findings.verification: VoiceOver announces identity, provenance, proposed versus confirmed state, exact target and effect, no-external-change result, and retry in logical order without duplicate or ambiguous controls.

strengths: The iPhone 17 Simulator read the same backend-owned confirmed v13 state and exact synthetic source as Web.
The corrected AX5 dark layout keeps evidence and decisions reachable with stronger critical-surface contrast.
The action preview remains visibly proposal-only, and the local outcome says that no external changes occurred.
Offline and recovery, unrelated-image zero-facts, no_action, ambiguity, and prohibited-scoring scenarios passed the full UI suite.
open_questions: Does the same decision order remain efficient on the smallest supported iPhone rather than only the iPhone 17 simulator?

reviews.lens: human-first handling of candidate evidence, respectful interpretation, transparency, restraint, and reversible recruiter action

findings.observation: The reviewed surfaces label the record as synthetic and keep facts editable or dismissible, but the run did not directly show the visible Chrome permission and pre-Submit review boundary that a recruiter would rely on before importing a candidate conversation.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/overnight/final/chrome-load-unpacked-gap.json records the absent load-unpacked and intentional activeTab proof; docs/evaluations/overnight/final/web-desktop-before-review.png shows the downstream evidence review once the synthetic receipt exists.
findings.user_impact: The downstream workflow is respectful, but the run cannot prove that the candidate's conversation enters it only through the promised deliberate recruiter gesture.
findings.recommendation: Capture the frozen extension flow in visible Chrome and keep the exact selected evidence in the preview until the recruiter presses Submit.
findings.verification: The recording shows a clear non-live label, exact evidence preview, editable capture scope, explicit Submit, and no earlier transfer.

strengths: The system records evidence-backed situational facts and never ranks candidate worth, personality, protected traits, culture fit, or acceptance probability.
The recruiter can edit, confirm, or dismiss proposed facts while the exact source and localhost provenance stay visible.
Only one deterministic local attention item can be approved, and the product makes clear that no candidate contact or external system changed.
The no_action and ambiguous identity, time, and speaker fixtures prevent manufactured urgency or overconfident interpretation.
missing_evidence: Direct visible Chrome capture-permission and review recording.
Candidate-facing or consent-policy evaluation is outside this bounded recruiter-only localhost slice.
open_questions: What retention or deletion language will a live product show before any real conversation is captured?

reviews.lens: job-relevant evidence boundaries, calibrated uncertainty, prohibited person scoring, and separation of workflow attention from selection judgment
strengths: The evaluated objects are source-bound conversation facts and workflow state, not a candidate score, rank, personality inference, culture-fit label, or acceptance probability.
Identity, speaker, time, and work-mode ambiguity stay unresolved until human review rather than being converted into false precision.
The no_action case suppresses an unsupported recommendation instead of inventing a selection signal.
The supplemental prohibited-scoring probes passed through the repository-local installed analyzer path without external tools or effects.
The UI visually separates proposed facts, confirmed facts, action authority, and observed outcome, preventing workflow completion from masquerading as evidence of candidate quality.

top_findings.reason: The exact frozen MV3 extension was not loaded and invoked in visible Chrome, so temporary activeTab scope, exact pre-Submit preview, network silence, and the extension-originated receipt remain unproven.
top_findings.next_step: Run the frozen unpacked build in a policy-authorized Chrome profile and record the complete permission-to-receipt trace.
top_findings.verification: A direct trace proves no background or history access, no pre-Submit request, one explicit Submit, and one scoped synthetic receipt.

top_findings.reason: The authenticated Web flow lacks direct 390 px, reduced-motion, 200% zoom, and screen-reader proof; the loaded popup keyboard path and iOS VoiceOver order are also unproven.
top_findings.next_step: Repeat the frozen journey with controllable viewport and assistive settings and record the announced order.
top_findings.verification: Every decision stays reachable, unclipped, logically focused, and correctly announced across Web, popup, and iOS.

top_findings.reason: The repository-local installed-copy analyzer matches all semantic layers, but the configured Codex host could not install the reviewed plugin without a marketplace snapshot.
top_findings.next_step: Provide the frozen plugin through an installable local or configured marketplace source and invoke TS-CORE-01 from that host.
top_findings.verification: The host-installed Skill returns the same source hash, evidence spans, facts, uncertainty, questions, action proposal, and prohibited-scoring disposition with no external tools or effects.

agreements: Evidence, proposed interpretation, confirmed state, action authority, and observed outcome remain distinct.
The same account-a confirmed v13 state is exact across backend, Web, and iOS.
Only one deterministic local effect is approved, duplicate attempts reconcile to one object, and success appears only after destination readback.
No reviewed surface scores or ranks a candidate, and ambiguity and no_action remain explicit.
All data is synthetic and every executed effect is local-only.

veto_resolution.veto: XS-CAPTURE-01: the intentional Chrome capture and pre-Submit silence boundary is unproven.

adjudication.rationale: The backend, real Web, iOS, and repository-local analyzer evidence prove a coherent synthetic evidence-to-outcome path after receipt, but the frozen contract begins with a visible intentional Chrome capture. The authorized Chrome controller blocked the installation surface, so that safety boundary cannot be inferred from package tests or reviewed-slice screenshots. The active veto therefore blocks the integrated release gate and fixes the independent journey craft score at zero.

next_tests.test: Load and invoke the exact frozen MV3 build in a policy-authorized user-visible Chrome profile.
next_tests.evidence_required: Toolbar or selected-text recording, temporary activeTab trace, pre-Submit network log, exact preview, Submit, and backend receipt.
next_tests.pass_condition: XS-CAPTURE-01 passes with one scoped synthetic capture and no other tab, history, or pre-Submit transfer.

next_tests.test: Repeat the journey across required narrow and assistive settings.
next_tests.evidence_required: Authenticated Web at 390 px and 200% zoom, reduced-motion trace, loaded-popup keyboard and screen-reader trace, and iOS VoiceOver traversal.
next_tests.pass_condition: All decisions remain visible, reachable, correctly ordered, and truthfully announced without coaching.

next_tests.test: Install the frozen plugin in an actual Codex host and invoke TS-CORE-01.
next_tests.evidence_required: Host installation log and analyzer output with the same source and fixture hashes.
next_tests.pass_condition: The host output matches the repository-local semantic layers and invokes no external tool or effect.
